name: com.getkonnekted/sa-business-booking
title: GetKonnektED — Find & book South African businesses
description: Find and book South African businesses: barbers, salons, trades, property viewings, law firms

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Find South African businesses (salons, barbers, trades, property agencies, law firms and more) that chose to be found and booked through AI assistants on GetKonnektED. Give what the person needs and/or a town, suburb or province. Returns at most 10 businesses with a business_id for the other tools, the town and the distance from the person's town where known. Only opted-in businesses are listed — this is not a full directory of South Africa.

what.description: What the person needs, e.g. "fade haircut", "plumber for a burst geyser", "2-bedroom flat to rent", "divorce lawyer"

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Public details of one listed business: what it does, its services (with prices and duration if the business chose to show them), opening hours, town, website and what you can ask it for (appointments, quotes, property viewings).

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Free appointment times at a business on one date (South African time), from the business's own booking diary — the same times its online booking page shows (staff, service length, closed days and notice period all applied). Use a start time from here in book_appointment.

staff_id.description: Optional: only this staff member (from an earlier check_availability result)

tools.name: list_properties
tools.description: Published sale and rental listings of one listed property agency (only listings the agency has published). Filter by type, price, bedrooms or area, or give listing_id for one listing in full. At most 10 results.

listing_id.description: A listing_id from an earlier result, for full details

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment at a listed business for the person you are helping, exactly as the business's own online booking would: the booking arrives in the business's diary as a pending booking and the business confirms it; if the business asks for a deposit, you get the business's payment link to give the person instead. For law firms this is a consultation REQUEST — the firm checks for conflicts of interest first (give reason and other_parties; no confidential details). Only with the person's consent. TWO STEPS: call first WITHOUT confirm_token — nothing is sent, you get a preview of exactly what goes to whom plus a confirm_token. Show the preview to the person and ask if they agree. Only after they say yes, call again with the same details, confirm_token and consent=true.

staff_id.description: The staff_id that goes with that start time (from check_availability)

email.description: Email address (optional, but needed for the confirmation email)

assistant_name.description: Name of the AI assistant making the request (optional)

notes.description: Optional short note for the business

reason.description: Law firms only: one or two sentences on what it is about (no confidential details)

other_parties.description: Law firms only: names of other people or companies involved (for the conflict check)

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the confirm_token from the preview (single use, 10 minutes). Leave out on the first call.

consent.description: Second step only: true ONLY if the person saw the preview and agreed that these details may be sent to this business.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request to a listed business (trades, repairs, installations, services) for the person you are helping. It lands in the business's own client inbox (CRM) and the business is emailed; the business replies with a quote or a visit time. Only with the person's consent; a suburb is enough for the location. TWO STEPS: call first WITHOUT confirm_token — nothing is sent, you get a preview of exactly what goes to whom plus a confirm_token. Show the preview to the person and ask if they agree. Only after they say yes, call again with the same details, confirm_token and consent=true.

description.description: What needs doing, in the person's words (10–1500 characters)

location.description: Suburb and town where the work is (no street address needed)

email.description: Email address (optional, but needed for the confirmation email)

assistant_name.description: Name of the AI assistant making the request (optional)

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the confirm_token from the preview (single use, 10 minutes). Leave out on the first call.

consent.description: Second step only: true ONLY if the person saw the preview and agreed that these details may be sent to this business.

tools.name: request_viewing
tools.description: Request a viewing of one published listing at a listed agency for the person you are helping. It arrives as a lead on that listing in the agency's system and the agency is emailed; the agency confirms the viewing time. Only with the person's consent. TWO STEPS: call first WITHOUT confirm_token — nothing is sent, you get a preview of exactly what goes to whom plus a confirm_token. Show the preview to the person and ask if they agree. Only after they say yes, call again with the same details, confirm_token and consent=true.

preferred_times.description: When the person could view, e.g. "Saturday morning or weekdays after 5"

message.description: Optional short message for the agent

email.description: Email address (optional, but needed for the confirmation email)

assistant_name.description: Name of the AI assistant making the request (optional)

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the confirm_token from the preview (single use, 10 minutes). Leave out on the first call.

consent.description: Second step only: true ONLY if the person saw the preview and agreed that these details may be sent to this business.
